create_Generator: create a BigGAN-deep Generator model with configurable depth, resolution, and class-conditional batch normalization
create_Discriminator: create a BigGAN-deep Discriminator model with spectral normalization, wide architecture, and projection discrimination
create_G_D: create a parallelized G_D module that combines Generator and Discriminator to minimize cross-GPU communication
create_GBlock: create a GBlock residual block with bottleneck convolutions, class-conditional batchnorm, and optional upsampling
create_DBlock: create a DBlock residual block with preactivation, bottleneck convolutions, and optional downsampling
